fact: The consolidated SmartBots strategy document, version 4.2 dated 16 December 2020, sets out per-pillar implementation plans and Gantt charts for 2020-2022 for public sector, education and monitoring and evaluation, with no stated costs in the text read.
title: Strategic Initiatives and Priority Setting: SMART BOTSWANA, Towards Digital Transformation for Batswana, Version 4.0 (Consolidated V4.2)
publisher: eGovlab, Stockholm University, for the Government of Botswana
